d: Iran continues to mock US President Donald Trump following the Republican Party's loss at the 2026 Midterm Elections. Iran has now shot down at least two MQ-9 reaper drones over the Strait of Hormuz this week. Iran has also captured at least 2 Lucas Drones. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps or the IRGC has released footage showing the downing of the two MQ-9 reaper drones. IRGC has also released footage of the captured Lucas drones, with Iranian troops seen taking selfies with the American Kamikaze Drone.
